neighbours.label: the person or group being held back or held down (held her back, hold a family down)
fire: Shyness held my brother back in school for years.
Her lack of a degree never held her back.

Don't let one bad review hold you back.

Prejudice held many talented women down in that era.
What is holding you back from applying?
